evidence: The body requires x1 to be non-null and compares the 32-bit value at x2+0 with the global 32-bit value at 0x70045ae9c4. On equality it loads the path pointer from x1+0, advances x2 by 4 only when x3>1, decrements x3, and tail-calls the accepted resolve_player_attribute_context_path helper (0x700183a0b0); otherwise it takes the fallback path. Its direct caller prepares the pointer/count arguments and invokes this helper in that path-resolution loop. decompiled/main/main_0140.c:27330-27350; caller decompiled/main/main_0140.c:27289-27316.

The entire body sets x1 to 1 and tail-calls the accepted remap_context_attribute_value_clamped helper (0x700070bbfc), preserving x0 and the other incoming state. This is the fixed-argument-1 wrapper for that remap operation; no meaning for argument 1 is asserted. A direct caller invokes this wrapper with a context object in x0. decompiled/main/main_0054.c:29277-29282; helper decompiled/main/main_0054.c:28313-28545; caller decompiled/main/main_0087.c:15207-15208.

If input+0x38 is non-null, the body passes that pointer and the 32-bit value at input+0x44 to a helper, copies the vector value from input+0x40, then tail-calls show_rtts_minigame_countdown_notification (0x7000ab99ac). If the pointer is null it returns without notification. The called notification function checks countdown thresholds and constructs the RTTS minigame notice. No direct C caller was found. decompiled/main/main_0053.c:15093-15115; notification helper decompiled/main/main_0076.c:25654-25695.

The body loads the resource-manager pointer from global 0x7002282f18, passes a nested pointer to the accepted resolve_leagues_resource helper (0x70009373a8), then stores 0xffffffff at offset +0xac of the returned object and tail-calls the accepted guest_state_noop_stub (0x70007df4d0). This describes the visible resource lookup and result-field initialization without assigning the field a source-level type. No direct C caller was found. decompiled/main/main_0077.c:40232-40252; resolver decompiled/main/main_0066.c:39517-39539; no-op decompiled/main/main_0059.c:8281-8285.

The body calls the accepted context-status getter (0x7001824b74) with selector 0x0a and stores the returned low byte at input+0x270. It then calls a helper that reads a word through the global context pointer, rotates/masks it to 15 bits and adds one; that result is stored at input+0x272 as a 16-bit value. No direct C caller was found, so the name sticks to the two observed stores and calculation. decompiled/main/main_0037.c:12907-12923; helper decompiled/main/main_0049.c:52578-52600.
